_purpose: Deployable site set for the egpt-godsworld PROD app. WITHOUT this manifest the CLI's legacy flow uploads the whole app directory. Site URLs are non-expiring and unsigned, so the set is an explicit ALLOWLIST: SiteWalker treats an empty `include` as match-everything. A new file under site/ must be added to `include` or the upload silently leaves it out.
_repo_root_excluded: The only source is `site`, so the repo-root assets/ and .descix/ are outside the walk and never uploaded. Do not add them as bare-name excludes: SiteWalker.isDirExcluded matches a bare directory name at ANY depth. Do not add a source whose path is `.` or a repo-root directory.
_schema: @descix/cli@1.0.20 ManifestLoader.validateSiteManifest: sources[] non-empty; each {path required string, include?/exclude? string arrays}; buildCommand string|null. Exclude is tested BEFORE include (exclude wins); directory excludes are bare names, no glob suffix.
